title: wtpool job ls --json, as the oracle reads jobs.md
description: The one JSON object `wtpool job ls --json` prints (J2): the `machine.jobs` object of S14, each job and process with the folder it works in in place of `worktree` and `actor`. Every listed field is required. The oracle's check also closes every object. Times are RFC 3339 UTC.

limit.description: How many jobs run at once, null while error is set (J5).

default.description: The default limit: a quarter of the cores, 1 to 8 (J5).

enforce.description: The policy for heavy commands outside a job (J21).

source.description: Where the limit and the policy each come from: machine.toml or the defaults (J4).

config.description: The path of machine.toml, whether it exists or not (J4).

error.description: Why the machine config or the job folder cannot be read, else null.

heavy.description: Each heavy pattern with its source (J20).

suggested.description: This repository's suggestions the heavy list lacks (J23).

from.description: The source it came from, such as the marker Cargo.toml or package.json; an open string.

waiting.description: The waiting jobs in queue order.

outside.description: The outermost heavy processes no job holds, newest first.

id.description: The job's id, or an id of a heavy process outside any job.

summary.description: The words of the heavy pattern it matches, else the summary of its arguments (J16).

folder.description: The absolute folder it works in.

since.description: When it started, or for a waiting job when it queued.
